title: Vintage Kodak Pocket Instamatic 10 Camera - Uses 110 Film
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Vintage Movie & Photography:Vintage Cameras:Other Vintage Cameras
descriptionText: The Vintage KODAK Pocket INSTAMATIC 10 Camera in Silver and Black color is a classic piece from the United States. This camera uses 110 film, providing a unique and retro photography experience. With its compact and easy-to-use design, this camera is perfect for capturing memories in a vintage style.
